critique: The exact labeled target-fiber equivalence, positive-noise realization, and complete subset-pivot enumeration are proved on the stated fixed-dimensional, nonnegative-shift, exact-rank/common-range model, so the central identification contribution clears the field tier. The consistency-versus-bounded-information results establish a genuine coarse classification boundary, although the finite-sample confidence construction is conservative rather than locally optimal. The project justification overstates the geometry-indexed local result: the note defines an optimization for an already-supplied Gaussian tangent geometry and compares two abstract Gaussian examples, but it does not derive the tangent cones or establish a local-experiment transfer for the covariance model itself. The result therefore does not furnish a model-specific local power characterization, and its substantive scope remains narrower than general signed heteroskedastic-shift or unknown-target models.
